$comment: YOFO Review's own contract (ADR 0014, plan 2026-10-01-standalone-review-app): the review bridge (crates/mib-bridge/src/review_bridge.rs, review_shim.cpp) and the YOFO Review shell. Separate from bridge-contract.json, the MIB Studio backend bridge ABI, which it never changes. C++ ties to these values via static_asserts in review_shim.cpp; Rust via tests/review_bridge.rs; TypeScript via the generated desktop/src/review/reviewContract.ts and desktop/src-tauri/src/review_packet_contract.rs (scripts/gen_bridge_contract.py --check fails CI on drift). Additive changes only: append values, never renumber or repurpose.

run_identity.source: run snapshot v3 (#712, /run_provenance @run_snapshot_json) and the planned annotation (/experiment_annotation @annotation_json, @annotation_schema_version); fetch_review_info.identity for the open file, review_probe_runs per file (review ABI 2, #717 B1a; emodulus_lut and profile_id since review ABI 3, #717 B3b; since review ABI 5, #783, emodulus_lut also reads a regenerated file's /experiment_info @emodulus_lut_json, named by emodulus_lut_provenance)
run_identity.members: snapshot_version, run_id, experiment_id, run_index, sample_ref, calibration_record_id, operator (id, name), annotation (sample, condition, experimental_unit, concentration {value, unit}, channel, medium, temperature_c, notes, free key/values sorted by key, schema_version), emodulus_lut (loaded, lut_id, revision, source, sha256, catalog_sha256, checksum_status: the snapshot v3 record, else a regenerated file's @emodulus_lut_json; the snapshot record wins, as in recording::readFileEModulusLut), emodulus_lut_provenance (review ABI 5, #783: one of emodulus_lut_provenances; snapshot = the run snapshot v3 record, the run's own; recorded = a regenerated file's record carried over from its source run; host = a regenerated file's record of the host's E-LUT at regeneration, the source recording none; absent exactly when emodulus_lut is), profile_id (the snapshot's profile_id, a non-empty string)
run_identity.absent_semantics: a member the file does not record is absent: has_* false over the review bridge, null in the shell's JSON; never 0, false or an empty string. A legacy file without a snapshot has has_snapshot false and every member absent, except that a file regenerated from #764 on (no snapshot) carries emodulus_lut and emodulus_lut_provenance (recorded or host) from its @emodulus_lut_json; a file regenerated before #764, or whose attribute is not a record (not an object, no boolean loaded, another provenance), reads both absent as before; a snapshot or annotation that is not a JSON object is reported unreadable, not absent

review_probe.semantics: review_probe_runs(paths): header attributes only (identity, start/end time, counts, run accounting, processing core version), no images or metadata rows; each count and time is read on its own: a missing or unreadable count is null and a recorded 0 stays 0, while a recorded 0 time is null (not recorded); one result per path in order; a file that cannot be read is a per-file error (ok false, message), never a failure of the call; refused as a whole above max_paths or while a review job runs; each file is read under the review session's own lock (HDF5 is not thread-safe, #722) and the open file is left as it was

review_track_rows.semantics: fetch_review_track_rows(valid, track_id, max): the records of the valid or invalid set whose track_id equals track_id (the linked records of one cell), in set order, at most max rows (max above max_rows is refused); positions are their indices in the set, parallel to rows; total counts every match and truncated says total > rows; served from the metadata read at open under the review session's lock, no HDF5 read; refused (ok false, message) for a negative track_id, a raw recording or no open file

review_reprocess_record.semantics: review_reprocess_record(valid, index, settings): the record's stored row next to what the review session's processing kernel finds in the same stored image now; never written anywhere. settings recorded = the file's recorded config, ROI and background (the defaults, said in settings_label, when the file records no config); default = the default config, the whole image, no background. core_version / core_source name the kernel that reprocessed it: the bundled core on a processing instance of the call's own (refused when the review session's active core is another), so no job's instance is touched. pixel_to_micron is the factor it ran and reports with (recorded: the file's, or the fallback when it records none; default: the processing default), named in settings_label; E-LUT (review ABI 4, #764): E (and an E-gated target group) is recomputed with the run's own E-LUT, the table whose bytes have the sha256 its run snapshot v3 emodulus_lut records (a regenerated file: its /experiment_info @emodulus_lut_json with provenance recorded), found among the session kernel's loaded LUT and the bundled LUT, never another; emodulus_lut names it (lut id, revision, the hash's first 12 hex digits) and emodulus_lut_sha256 is its full hash, also named in settings_label. A run that records loaded false gets no E, as it had none; a file without that record (no snapshot, or one before v3), or whose @emodulus_lut_json names only a host's LUT (provenance host), keeps the behaviour before ABI 4 (E not recomputed, settings_label says what the file records). emodulus_recomputed is false in both cases, emodulus_lut and emodulus_lut_sha256 are then empty over the review bridge and null in the shell's JSON, and the reprocessed rows' E is not recomputed (E null). reprocessed holds the objects found (an image with none gives no rows), at most max_objects (truncated), with the record's frame index and no track; match_index (has_match) is the reprocessed object whose centroid, in image coordinates, is nearest the stored one inside the stored bounding box, the stored box and centroid placed in image coordinates through the file's review_object_coordinates; reprocessed rows are image coordinates, stored as stored; object_count_differs when the kernel found another number of objects than a stored object_count above 0. The inputs are read under the job lanes' lock and the review session's lock (HDF5 is not thread-safe, #722); processing runs outside every lock. Refused (ok false, message) while a review job runs, for a raw recording, an index outside the set, a record without a stored image, a file whose object coordinate space is unknown, a run whose recorded E-LUT has no hash or is not available here (the reason names it), an unknown settings value, or when the kernel fails on the image

review_run_statistics.semantics: Review ABI 6 (#716 A7a, building on review ABI 5, #783): review_run_statistics(request_json) -> the JSON document of bridge-contract.json run_quick_look (request, reply, run, statistics and delta exactly as there), computed by the same C++ function (backend::review::computeRunStatistics) for B2 R2's per-run numbers. Each file is read with a short-lived reader of its own under the review session's lock (HDF5 is not thread-safe, #722), gated on the job lanes: while a review job runs every uncached file is deferred, never an error. There is no cache here (computed_at "on_demand", from_cache false) and no instrument, so nothing else defers it. Paths are used as given (no storage root). A read: nothing is written to a file, a store or a snapshot.

review_object_coordinates.semantics: fetch_review_info.object_coordinates (review ABI 3, #756 review 2): the space of the open file's stored bounding boxes and centroids, decided once at open under the review session's lock, in this order: (attribute) /experiment_info @object_coordinates, written from #756 on by the capture path (roi_local for the inline realtime path with an ROI, image otherwise; not written for PL-science runs) and by regenerate / reanalysis (image); (snapshot) a run snapshot v3 of a host-science run: an ROI with w, h > 0 under realtime_mode inline is roi_local, async_batch or no ROI image, another mode does not decide; (roi_origin) an ROI without area or at origin (0, 0): image, both placements being the same; (mask_check) up to max_records records with a mask and a box, the valid set spread over first and the invalid set only to fill the rest: a record votes for the placement of its stored box (as stored, or shifted by the ROI origin) where the stored object is, by identity, not by pixel count: an 8-connected mask component overlapping the placed box whose bounding box has an IoU of at least min_box_iou_percent with it and, where the record has an area, whose measured contour's convex-hull area is within area_tolerance_percent of it (a hole of the component for a Contract 1 inner-contour object, which also needs a hole; its outline otherwise); a record is decisive only when exactly one placement fits, and the file is that space with at least min_decisive decisive votes agreeing at min_agreement_percent or more; otherwise unknown (source empty). object_origin_x / object_origin_y place a stored box or centroid in image coordinates (the ROI origin for roi_local, 0 otherwise). Unknown for a raw recording (no objects) and no open file. Whatever needs the placement (the reprocess match, a cell crop) refuses an unknown space; it never guesses

frame_packet.base: bridge-contract.json frame_packet: the same magic, version, header layout, byte order and limits
frame_packet.identity_semantics: capture_session and store_generation are zero: review frames come from a recorded file, not a capture
frame_packet.rgb8_semantics: review pulls (kinds 3, 5, 6) may carry RGB8 (3 bytes per pixel, stride = width*3) when the backend composed an overlay or ROI; mono pulls are unchanged
frame_packet.thumbnail_strip_semantics: pull kind 5 packs count tiles of size x size as one frame of width size and height size*count; frame_index = page offset

review_density.ramp_semantics: backend/processing/MonitoringDensity.h densityRampColor: linear interpolation over the stops, t in [0,1]; level k of n uses t = k/(n-1) (kdeLevelColor)
